name: Guardian of the Crystallizer
text: Bonded (Crystallizer of Dreams). Hunter. Prey - Investigator with a Crystallizer of Dreams only. Guardian of the Crystallizer enters play exhausted. Forced - If there is no Crystallizer of Dreams in play: Set Guardian of the Crystallizer aside, out of play.
text_cn: 绑定(梦境结晶器)。猎手。 猎物 -仅对有梦境结晶器的调查员。 结晶器守卫以消耗状态入场。 强制 - 如果场上没有梦境结晶器：将结晶器守卫放在一边，位于场外。
